[m1][user] walk me through how session ingest works end to end

[m2][assistant] Ingest has four stages. 1) Claude Code hooks fire on each turn but only signal liveness. 2) The client tails the transcript JSONL and posts the delta since the last offset. 3) The server ingest worker parses each line, upserts messages and tool events, and advances the offset per element so one bad line can't wedge the stream. 4) An embedding job vectorizes new messages in batches of 64 for search.

[m3][user] great. and remember I always want the transcript delta treated as the only source of truth, hooks are just pings
